description: This file declares the em_cmd_agent_t class, which extends em_cmd_exec_t and is part of a command execution framework for a Wi-Fi mesh agent. It includes method declarations for executing commands, sending results, and creating events, as well as constructors for initializing the command agent with various inputs.
